t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
st: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
d: Sean says his wife has made him so angry that he’s put her in the hospital over 10 times. Sean’s also got a secret of his own — he is really a she! Can Steve help Sean iron out his issues?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Real Teens: Real Topics
d: Steve’s hosting another teen girl town hall to address critical issues all teen girls could face, including drug use, physical abuse, and online predators. No question is off limits!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Rescues a Runaway
d: Sherry was attacked at 15 and ran away from home. She wants Steve’s help with reuniting her with her mother. Then, Dawn's teenage daughter Cathy recently gave birth, but lives in fear of the baby’s unemployed and unstable father Nick.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Look What You Did to Your Baby
st: Look What You Did to Your Baby
d: Kristy wants her baby back from her mother Donna! Donna claims she took the baby away because he was born with severe disabilities due to Kristy’s drug use during pregnancy. Who’s the liar?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Teen Mom Murderer?
d: At 17, Janelle's infant son died from serious injuries. She was sentenced to 3 years in prison for reckless homicide, but claims she's innocent. What will her polygraph results say?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Betrayal
d: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
st: I Did It To Hurt You
d: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
st: I Left You, But You Are The Father
d: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
st: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
d: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
d: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
st: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
d: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son.  But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
st: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
d: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
d: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
d: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
st: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
d: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: 13-Year-Old Father?
d: Curtis sat down with his mother Telisha, and told her that he is trying to have a baby but Telisha was shocked and terrified because Curtis is only 13 years old! Curtis insists he is ready to be a father.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
st: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
d: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
d: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

t: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
st: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
d: Devon slipped into a coma and is on life support. But before he fell into a coma, he told his mother that his ex Alisha said he did not father their son. Alisha denies ever saying this and feels his whole family has turned their backs on her.

t: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheaters Come Clean
d: Couples reveal they have been cheating on today's Jerry Springer Show. Candice confronts Nikki for sleeping with her man and Mike suspects Moon has been cheating with two people.

t: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell Feast
d: Melody is horrified that her sister, Amanda, is ruining her life by dating a 54 year old biker and loser named Wolf. Today they'll face off against Amanda's entire family!

t: The Jerry Springer Show: Homewreckers Confronted
d: Linda says her former best friend is trying to steal her man and she's fighting back! Then, Sherry wants her boyfriend Terry's wife Sandy and her family out of their lives!

t: The Jerry Springer Show: Wives Battle Mistresses
d: Today, Vicki will face her husband Jason and his lover with an ultimatum and Anna admits she’s trying to steal Misty’s husband – again!
